$description: SYSTEM colour roles, DARK mode (studio night) — what a colour is FOR. Same names as mode.light.json; a surface picks which is its base.

surface-raised.$description: The emphasised layer — hover fills, chips, raised cards.

text-muted.$description: Secondary ink — stays WCAG AA; never dim with opacity (0376).

text-faint.$description: Placeholders only — must read as absence, not content.

accent.$description: Cinnabar, lifted for the dark ground — the one pigment (Law 01).

accent-tint.$description: A whisper of the accent for selected / focus fills.

on-accent.$description: Paper ink on a cinnabar fill.

focus-ring.$description: Focus is a tint ring, never a halo (Law 04).

warning.$description: Draft / dirty / attention — a tint, never a fill (Law 02).

shadow.$description: The shadow ink, mixed into every box-shadow.

ring.$description: The mark's ring — a white sticker on the dark ground.
